scripts.test: bun run test:js && bun run test:php
scripts.lint:php: out=$(php bin/pretty-php.phar --check api index.php tests 2>&1); code=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out"; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^\^ ' && { echo 'lint:php FAIL: pretty-php reports problems (braceless control-structure body or empty statement); add braces.' >&2; exit 1; }; exit $code
scripts.fix: oxlint --fix && oxfmt && php bin/pretty-php.phar api index.php tests
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run format:php:check && bun run lint:php && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:css && bun run test && bun run stan && bun run build
scripts.test:e2e:ci: start-server-and-test 'bun run serve' http://127.0.0.1:8000 'bun run test:e2e'
